requirements: R1: The elevator starts in the Idle state at floor 1 with doors closed and no pending destination.
R2: When a hall call or cabin floor request is registered while in Idle, the elevator moves to the Moving state toward the requested floor.
R3: When the elevator arrives at the requested floor while in Moving, it stops and moves to the DoorsOpening state.
R4: When doors finish opening while in DoorsOpening, the elevator moves to the DoorsOpen state.
R5: When the door-close command is issued or the door-open timer expires while in DoorsOpen, the elevator moves to the DoorsClosing state.
R6: When doors finish closing while in DoorsClosing and no further pending requests exist, the elevator returns to Idle at the current floor.
R7: When doors finish closing while in DoorsClosing and a pending request exists, the elevator moves to Moving toward the next requested floor.
R8: When the overload sensor activates while in DoorsOpen, the elevator moves to the Overload state and prevents door closing until load is reduced.
R9: When the overload condition is cleared while in Overload, the elevator returns to DoorsOpen.
R10: When the emergency-stop button is pressed in any operational state, the elevator moves to EmergencyStopped and halts motion immediately.
R11: When the operator releases the emergency stop while in EmergencyStopped, the elevator returns to Idle at the current floor with doors closed.
R12: The elevator must not move while doors are in the DoorsOpen or DoorsOpening state.
R13: The elevator must not open doors while in the Moving state.
